---
title: "Codebook"
---

Every variable in the published index, in one place. For the conceptual
methodology (why the index is built this way), see
[Documentation](/pages/documentation.html); this page is the quick
reference for what a specific column actually means once you've
downloaded the data.

Range, missing-value counts, and distinct-value counts below are computed
live from the current published dataset every time this page is built --
not hand-typed, so they can't silently drift out of sync with the actual
data the way a static codebook could.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".")
import pandas as pd
import _site_helpers as sh
from IPython.display import HTML, display

df = pd.read_csv("data/2025/output/index_2025.csv")

display(HTML(f"""
<p><strong>Dataset:</strong> index_2025.csv &middot;
<strong>Observations:</strong> {len(df)} country-years &middot;
<strong>Variables:</strong> {len(df.columns)}</p>
"""))

display(HTML(sh.build_codebook_html(df)))
```
